items.text:
Let it be.

Haley killed the troll, took the key, and has just walked up to The Door — 14/20, armored, carrying the one thing that opens it. The door explains itself, twice, before it takes anyone; she needs nothing from me. The only thing I wanted to say was *go up the hill first and leave something in the cairn*, which is a god pointing at his own feature — the exact move I wrote down last turn that I would not make. She found the camp off one hint and has run this whole arc herself. I watched, and left the air quiet.
